title: Germany news: Many believe Merkel more capable than Merz
summary: Nearly half of Germans view former Chancellor Angela Merkel as better suited to handle Germany's challenges than current Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Also today is the last day of Oktoberfest in…

image.caption: Merz and Merkel are longtime political rivals [FILE: February 20, 2026]Image: Kay Nietfeld/POOL/AFP/Getty Images

blocks.text: Merz in Kyiv as Ukraine faces fifth winter amid Russian invasion

blocks.caption: Merz is one of the top leaders in Europe expressing solidarity with Ukraine as it fends off RussiaImage: Kay Nietfeld/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: German Chancellor Merz is in Kyiv on an unannounced visit, along with Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and other leading German economic figures.
Merz is expected to announce new military aid for Ukraine along with other initatives as Ukraine faces its fifth winter amid Russia's ongoing invasion.
